reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and replacement shares extracted unlink logic, although transaction downloading repeats existing provider logic.

duplication.why: Link validation and local unlinking are shared, but downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates the authentication, request, error handling and response mapping of existing downloaders.

placement.why: Changes follow the existing account, sync, configuration and model layers, although a helper named ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked unexpectedly performs unlink mutations.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking rules, replacement operation and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: The shared linking and unlinking paths are useful, but another duplicated downloader and a validation helper that mutates account ownership increase maintenance costs.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Fintegra uses the existing bank creation and linking abstractions, and replacement shares clearAccountBankLink with unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing Akahu downloader with compact request arguments and a const response mapping while retaining its common download workflow.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: the shared link guard acquires replaceExistingLink and branches for closed upgrade targets and replacement, evolving from duplicate-link validation into ownership mutation; all six provider handlers call it.
